newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tsutsumi shares fall on lower 97/98 forecast.
newsitem.headline: Tsutsumi shares fall on lower 97/98 forecast.

text.p: Shares in Tsutsumi Jewelry Co Ltd dropped on Friday on the Tokyo Stock Exchange following the firm's gloomy earnings forecast for the year ending March 1998.
The shares fell 130 yen to 2,600 yen with turnover of 20,300 by 0109 GMT, making it the biggest percentage loser on the first section of the bourse.
The major jewellery retailer had announced on Thursday that it expects a parent current profit of 5.45 billion yen in 1997/98, down 16.4 percent from a year earlier.
